query:
SELECT
            started_at::date           AS "date!: NaiveDate",
            COALESCE(SUM(duration_seconds) / 60, 0) AS "focus_minutes!: i64"
        FROM   focus_sessions
        WHERE  user_id   = $1
          AND  started_at::date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
          AND  ended_at  IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY started_at::date
        ORDER BY started_at::date ASC
